name: manual_f8b66f
claim: When two branches independently fix the same narrow bug and one fix is part of a broader systematic rework already landed on origin/main, prefer the systematic upstream version during merge over keeping a smaller manual point-fix, even if the manual fix is correct -- reduces future duplicate-fix drift and keeps the fix consistent with whatever else the systematic rework touched.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-22/23: this branch hand-fixed a session-scratch-path leak in a graduated lesson file; origin/main independently fixed the identical class of leak as part of a repo_hygiene.py -> repo_hygiene_core.py rework touching many files. Took origin/main's version on merge -- functionally identical content, but consistent with the rest of that rework instead of a one-off.
